archetypes.name: Distrustful pessimistic institution-skeptics
archetypes.text: These respondents combine deep distrust of other people and institutions with bleak views of national democracy, the economy, and their own finances, yet they are not disengaged: many are highly interested in politics and actively verify information online. Their pessimism spans personal, social, and national levels at once, and they often feel worried about technology and automation while still describing ordinary family and social life as routine or moderately happy.

archetypes.name: Distrustful routine traditionalist
archetypes.text: Deeply distrustful of people and institutions, yet emotionally content and financially stable. Despite holding a very low opinion of democratic processes and public bodies, they report being very happy and feel reasonably well-off. Their life is routine and centered on family rather than outside social circles, and they hold traditional views on gender and work. They are skeptical of technology and automation, feel uneasy about robots and AI, and think science receives too much funding. The pairing of high personal contentment with thorough institutional cynicism is the distinctive feature.
